notes: Circuit: five op-amp stages, the same architecture as the other sheets in this set. A 5V source is buffered by op-amp #2 (1uF feedback) and a 10A current source is buffered by op-amp #14 (1uH feedback); #14's output forms the middle bus, which drives the in+ of the summing stage #3 directly and the inverting stages #11 (through capacitor #12) and #19 (through capacitor #20); the outputs of #3, #11 and #19 are summed on the right-hand vertical bus through R5, R13 and R21. NET MAP: n1 = the horizontal at y~186 from x=100 to the upper input of op-amp #2 (265,181), with the vertical x~218 up to the left plate of the 1uF cap #0 (S13) and the vertical x~102 down to the top of the 5V source #6. n2 = the output of op-amp #2 (383,202) right to S15 (428,199), up x~430 to the right plate of cap #0, and on to the left end of R4. n3 = the right end of R4 (533,198) to S14 (593,193), up x~593 to the left lead of inductor #1, and right to the upper input of op-amp #3 (647,190). n4 = the output of op-amp #3 (764,199) to S18 (792,203), up x~792 to (792,110) and left to the right lead of inductor #1, plus the left end of R5. n5 = the middle bus: the lower input of op-amp #3 (647,244) down to (555,325) and down the vertical x~555 to y~805, then right to the left plate of capacitor #20; the horizontal at y~495 crossing it at S43 carries the output of op-amp #14 (429,626, up the x~480 riser at S45), the right lead of inductor #10 and the left plate of capacitor #12. n6 = the right-hand summing bus: the right end of R5 (901,204) right to x~975 and down to y~840, joined by the right end of R13 at S48 (971,533) and the right end of R21 at S67 (936,839). n7 = the right plate of capacitor #12 (658,492) to S44 (709,495), then to the upper input of op-amp #11 (762,497), with the riser up to the left plate of capacitor #9. n8 = the right plate of capacitor #9 down x~880 to the output of op-amp #11 (855,526) at S47, plus the left end of R13. n9 = the left lead of inductor #10 (354,494) down x~327 to S55 (325,590), the horizontal y~595 to the upper input of op-amp #14 (339,591), and left to x~250 then down to the top of the 10A source #16. n10 = the right plate of capacitor #20 (683,808) to S63 (711,809) and the upper input of op-amp #19 (740,810), with the riser up x~711 to the left lead of inductor #17. n11 = the output of op-amp #19 (838,837) to S64 (862,833), up to the right lead of inductor #17, and right to the left end of R21. '0' = the five GND symbols #7, #8, #15, #18, #22 with the bottom of the 5V source, the bottom of the 10A source, and the lower (+) inputs of op-amps #2, #11 and #19. JUDGEMENT CALLS: S43 (561,495) is the only genuine ambiguity in this drawing - the middle-bus vertical (x~561) and the horizontal at y~495 cross in a plain X. The pixel dump at (561,495) shows the vertical running straight through rows 473-517 with no arc, no jog and no blob (only a 2-pixel kink where the two strokes overlap), i.e. no hop and no solder dot. Read as JUNCTION on the ink prior: this drafter draws no hops anywhere on the sheet (all 51 sites are either plain Ts of real wires or handwriting brushing a lead), so a bare crossing is a real node. The alternative (crossing) would split the bus into {op-amp #3 in+, capacitor #20 left plate} - a pair with no DC path and no driver, leaving the summing stage's second input floating - and would leave op-amp #14's output feeding only #11; the junction reading gives #14's output the same fan-out role that the equivalent stage has on the companion sheets. S13 (218,186), S14 (593,193), S15 (428,199), S18 (792,203), S44 (709,495), S45 (480,496), S48 (971,533), S55 (325,590), S63 (711,809), S64 (862,833), S67 (936,839) are all plain Ts where one wire terminates on another, confirmed junction from the 5x crops; a crossing reading at any of them would strand a feedback element or an op-amp output on a one-terminal net. The non-critical sites S1-S12, S19-S23, S28-S31, S37-S42, S47, S49-S51, S58-S61, S66, S69-S74 are all handwritten value labels ('1uF', '1uH', '1KOhm', '2KOhm', '5V') touching a wire and were left at the tracer default; none changes the netlist. UNCONNECTED LEAD: op-amp #14 (385,614) - its lower (+) input lead runs left from the symbol at (340,645) to (333,650) and then down to (333,699), where the ink simply stops. The pixel dump at (313,720) with a 26-pixel window is completely empty, so the lead reaches neither the 10A source column (x~250) nor the GND symbol #18 (254,786). Every other op-amp on the sheet takes its + input to its own GND symbol, so the drafter almost certainly meant ground, but nothing is drawn, so component 14 is flagged unconnected and terminal 14.0 is left null rather than inventing the connection. PIN ORDER: the required order is (in+, in-, out). The +/- marks were read at 7x zoom inside all five triangles - #2, #3, #11, #14 and #19 every one has the minus beside the upper input and the plus beside the lower input - so in- = upper lead and in+ = lower lead throughout. This also matches the physical reading in every case: the feedback element (cap #0, inductor #1, cap #9, inductor #10, inductor #17) lands on the upper input of its own stage. The tracer's default numbering did not follow the required order for #2, #3, #11, #14 or #19, so all five were re-pointed. CLASSES: all 23 symbols agree with the drawing. One thing worth flagging for the record but NOT changed: component #12 at (636,493) is annotated Capacitor and the symbol drawn there really is a capacitor (two parallel vertical plates straddling the wire, clearly visible at 7x and in the S39/S41/S42 crops), yet the value written above it reads '1KOhm'. That is a drafter's value/symbol mismatch, not an annotation error, so the class stands.
